appDescription: Trade on real markets in real-time with demo funds.
selectARobotDescription: Choose your AI trading partner. A minimum of ${initialBalance} is required to start.
tradeHistoryDescription: A log of all executed trades.
noTrades: No trades yet. Start the robot to see trading activity.
simulatorPausedDesc: Robot changed. The simulator has been paused.
sessionResetDesc: Your account has been reset to the initial state.
withdrawDescription: Trading is conducted with real-time market data. To withdraw funds, you need to activate a full account for $150. Please contact your manager to proceed.
robotRiskAverseDescription: Capital preservation with steady, smaller returns.
robotBalancedDescription: A balance between capital preservation and growth.
tutorialWelcomeContent: This is an interactive tour to get you started. You're using a demo account, but the trading data is real. If this were a real account, your profits could be withdrawn.
tutorialSelectRobotContent: First, select one of the AI trading robots. Each has a different strategy, from low-risk to high-growth.
tutorialClickRobotContent: Go ahead and click on any robot to select it. We recommend starting with the 'Balanced Robot'.
tutorialStartTradingContent: Great! Now just press this button to start the trading simulation. The robot will start making trades automatically.
tutorialFinishedContent: The robot is now trading. You can watch the trade history fill up. You can stop the simulation at any time. Good luck!
